detail.body:
## Changes

Enable decoder SWA bounded replay with CUDA DP attention (attention TP=1) for MegaMoE and TP MoE. Update late-layer row counts, token IDs and padding masks, then restore the full batch layout for logits/DSpark. Keep target peers eager during coordinated prefill so their collectives agree.

TRT-LLM and prefill CUDA graphs remain unsupported with bounded replay.

## Accuracy

DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, 2×GB300, TP2/DP2/EP2, MegaMoE + FlashMLA, native DSpark acceptance. GSM8K: 1,314 scored questions, five-shot chat, thinking disabled, temperature 0, concurrency 64, max output 4,096 tokens.

| Configuration | Correct | Accuracy | Request errors |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Replay disabled | 1,278 / 1,314 | 97.26% | 0 |
| Decoder replay enabled | 1,281 / 1,314 | 97.49% | 0 |

Neither run reached the output limit.

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, List, Optional
+
+import torch

+from sglang.srt.layers.dp_attention import DpPaddingMode, set_dp_buffer_len_from_batch
+from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_parallel

+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from sglang.srt.model_executor.forward_batch_info import ForwardBatch

+def late_layer_dp_counts(
+    forward_batch: ForwardBatch, local_late_rows: int
+) -> Optional[List[int]]:
+    # Bounded replay shrinks an extending rank's late layers to its tail, but the
+    # TP-MoE gather / combine there spans every DP rank, so each rank needs all
+    # ranks' late-layer row counts. Eager forwards only: every rank takes this
+    # branch together, and graph replays never reach the late-layer switch.
+    early = forward_batch.global_num_tokens_padded_cpu
+    if early is None:
+        early = forward_batch.global_num_tokens_cpu
+    if early is None or torch.cuda.is_current_stream_capturing():
+        return None
+    device = forward_batch.global_num_tokens_gpu.device
+    local = torch.tensor([local_late_rows], dtype=torch.int64, device=device)
+    counts = torch.empty(len(early), dtype=torch.int64, device=device)
+    get_parallel().tp_group.all_gather_into_tensor(counts, local)
+    counts = counts.tolist()
+    return None if counts == list(early) else counts
+
+
+def enter_late_layer_dp(forward_batch: ForwardBatch, counts: List[int]) -> tuple:
+    fb = forward_batch
+    saved = (
+        fb.global_num_tokens_cpu,
+        fb.global_num_tokens_gpu,
+        fb.global_num_tokens_padded_cpu,
+        fb.global_num_tokens_for_logprob_cpu,
+        fb.global_num_tokens_for_logprob_gpu,
+        fb.global_dp_buffer_len,
+        fb.dp_padding_mode,
+        fb.dp_local_start_pos,
+        fb.dp_local_num_tokens,
+        fb.global_num_token_non_padded,
+        fb.global_num_token_non_padded_cpu,
+        fb.num_token_non_padded,
+    )
+    fb.global_num_tokens_cpu = counts
+    fb.global_num_tokens_gpu = torch.tensor(
+        counts, dtype=torch.int64, device=fb.global_num_tokens_gpu.device
+    )
+    fb.global_num_tokens_padded_cpu = counts
+    # The MoE gatherv reads its sizes from the logprob counts when present.
+    fb.global_num_tokens_for_logprob_cpu = counts
+    fb.global_num_tokens_for_logprob_gpu = fb.global_num_tokens_gpu
+    fb.global_dp_buffer_len = sum(counts)
+    # Tail rows are real rows only, so the late layers gather variable lengths.
+    fb.dp_padding_mode = DpPaddingMode.SUM_LEN
+    fb.dp_local_start_pos = fb.dp_local_num_tokens = None
+    # With attention TP=1 the invariant scalar also describes local MoE rows.
+    # Preserve an idle peer's zero bound even when it carries fabricated rows.
+    local_rows = counts[get_parallel().attn_dp_rank]
+    real_rows = min(local_rows, fb.global_num_token_non_padded_cpu)
+    fb.global_num_token_non_padded_cpu = real_rows
+    if fb.global_num_token_non_padded is not None:
+        fb.global_num_token_non_padded = fb.global_num_token_non_padded.new_tensor(
+            real_rows
+        )
+        fb.num_token_non_padded = fb.global_num_token_non_padded
+    set_dp_buffer_len_from_batch(fb)
+    return saved
+
+
+def exit_late_layer_dp(forward_batch: ForwardBatch, saved: tuple) -> None:
+    fb = forward_batch
+    (
+        fb.global_num_tokens_cpu,
+        fb.global_num_tokens_gpu,
+        fb.global_num_tokens_padded_cpu,
+        fb.global_num_tokens_for_logprob_cpu,
+        fb.global_num_tokens_for_logprob_gpu,
+        fb.global_dp_buffer_len,
+        fb.dp_padding_mode,
+        fb.dp_local_start_pos,
+        fb.dp_local_num_tokens,
+        fb.global_num_token_non_padded,
+        fb.global_num_token_non_padded_cpu,
+        fb.num_token_non_padded,
+    ) = saved
+    set_dp_buffer_len_from_batch(fb)

+"""Late-layer DP geometry must be restored before logits/DSpark processing."""
+
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase, maybe_stub_sgl_kernel
+
+maybe_stub_sgl_kernel()
+
+from sglang.srt.arg_groups.deepseek_v4_hook import validate_deepseek_v41_features
+from sglang.srt.layers.dp_attention import (
+    DpPaddingMode,
+    get_dp_global_num_tokens,
+    get_global_dp_buffer_len,
+    get_local_dp_buffer_len,
+    set_dp_buffer_len_from_batch,
+)
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.cuda_graph_config import (
+    Backend,
+    CudaGraphConfig,
+    PhaseConfig,
+)
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.forward_batch_info import ForwardBatch, ForwardMode
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.swa_replay_dp import (
+    enter_late_layer_dp,
+    exit_late_layer_dp,
+    late_layer_dp_counts,
+)
+from sglang.srt.runtime_context import get_context, get_parallel, override_platform
+from sglang.srt.server_args import ServerArgs
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=2, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+class TestSWAReplayDP(CustomTestCase):
+    @override_platform(is_cuda=True, is_hip=False)
+    def test_validation_allows_only_supported_dp_geometry(self):
+        for backend, tp, dp, attention in (
+            ("megamoe", 2, 2, "flashmla"),
+            ("none", 2, 2, "flashmla"),
+            ("megamoe", 4, 2, "flashmla"),
+            ("deepep", 2, 2, "flashmla"),
+            ("megamoe", 2, 2, "trtllm"),
+        ):
+            with self.subTest(backend=backend, tp=tp, dp=dp, attention=attention):
+                args = ServerArgs(
+                    model_path="dummy",
+                    cuda_graph_config=CudaGraphConfig(
+                        prefill=PhaseConfig(backend=Backend.DISABLED)
+                    ),
+                    tp_size=tp,
+                    attn_dp_size=dp,
+                    moe_a2a_backend=backend,
+                    dsv4_attn_backend=attention,
+                    enable_decoder_swa_bounded_replay=True,
+                )
+                args._model_config = SimpleNamespace(
+                    hf_config=SimpleNamespace(model_type="deepseek_v41")
+                )
+                if (
+                    tp == dp
+                    and backend in ("none", "megamoe")
+                    and attention == "flashmla"
+                ):
+                    validate_deepseek_v41_features(args)
+                else:
+                    with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "DP attention|TRT-LLM"):
+                        validate_deepseek_v41_features(args)
+
+    def test_decode_peer_stays_eager_on_a_prefill_step(self):
+        from sglang.srt.model_executor.runner.decode_cuda_graph_runner import (
+            DecodeCudaGraphRunner,
+        )
+
+        graph = DecodeCudaGraphRunner.__new__(DecodeCudaGraphRunner)
+        graph.require_mlp_sync = True
+        graph.model_runner = SimpleNamespace(is_draft_worker=False)
+        with get_context().override_server_args(enable_decoder_swa_bounded_replay=True):
+            self.assertFalse(
+                graph.can_run_graph(SimpleNamespace(is_extend_in_batch=True))
+            )
+
+    def test_tail_geometry_and_idle_mask_are_transactional(self):
+        for rank, real_rows in ((0, 1024), (1, 0)):
+            with (
+                self.subTest(rank=rank),
+                get_context().override_server_args(tp_size=2, attn_dp_size=2),
+                get_parallel().override(attn_dp_rank=rank, attn_tp_size=1),
+            ):
+                fb = ForwardBatch(
+                    forward_mode=ForwardMode.EXTEND,
+                    batch_size=1,
+                    input_ids=torch.zeros(1024, dtype=torch.long),
+                    req_pool_indices=torch.tensor([0]),
+                    seq_lens=torch.tensor([1024]),
+                    out_cache_loc=torch.arange(1024),
+                    seq_lens_sum=1024,
+                    global_num_tokens_cpu=[1024, 1024],
+                    global_num_tokens_gpu=torch.tensor([1024, 1024]),
+                    global_num_tokens_padded_cpu=[1024, 1024],
+                    global_num_tokens_for_logprob_cpu=[1024, 0],
+                    global_dp_buffer_len=2048,
+                    dp_padding_mode=DpPaddingMode.MAX_LEN,
+                    dp_local_start_pos=torch.tensor(rank * 1024),
+                    dp_local_num_tokens=torch.tensor(1024),
+                    global_num_token_non_padded=torch.tensor(real_rows),
+                    global_num_token_non_padded_cpu=real_rows,
+                    num_token_non_padded=torch.tensor(real_rows),
+                )
+                set_dp_buffer_len_from_batch(fb)
+                original = dict(vars(fb))
+                saved = enter_late_layer_dp(fb, [128, 0])
+                self.assertEqual(get_dp_global_num_tokens(), [128, 0])
+                self.assertEqual(get_global_dp_buffer_len(), 128)
+                self.assertEqual(get_local_dp_buffer_len(), 128 if rank == 0 else 0)
+                self.assertEqual(
+                    fb.num_token_non_padded.item(), 128 if rank == 0 else 0
+                )
+                self.assertEqual(fb.global_num_tokens_for_logprob_cpu, [128, 0])
+                self.assertIsNone(fb.dp_local_start_pos)
+                exit_late_layer_dp(fb, saved)
+                for name, value in original.items():
+                    self.assertIs(getattr(fb, name), value, name)
+                self.assertEqual(get_dp_global_num_tokens(), [1024, 1024])
+                self.assertEqual(get_local_dp_buffer_len(), 1024)
+
+    def test_every_peer_publishes_its_own_late_rows(self):
+        class Collective:
+            def all_gather_into_tensor(self, output, local):
+                self.local = local.item()
+                output.copy_(torch.tensor([128, 5]))
+
+        collective = Collective()
+        fb = ForwardBatch(
+            forward_mode=ForwardMode.IDLE,
+            batch_size=0,
+            input_ids=torch.empty(0),
+            req_pool_indices=torch.empty(0),
+            seq_lens=torch.empty(0),
+            out_cache_loc=torch.empty(0),
+            seq_lens_sum=0,
+            global_num_tokens_cpu=[1024, 5],
+            global_num_tokens_gpu=torch.tensor([1024, 5]),
+        )
+        with (
+            get_parallel().override(tp_group=collective),
+            patch("torch.cuda.is_current_stream_capturing", return_value=False),
+        ):
+            self.assertEqual(late_layer_dp_counts(fb, 5), [128, 5])
+            self.assertEqual(collective.local, 5)
+            fb.global_num_tokens_padded_cpu = [128, 5]
+            self.assertIsNone(late_layer_dp_counts(fb, 5))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
